note: Point-in-time public-address snapshot only. Review excluded/burn/contract addresses and approve the recipient list before any airdrop. New transfers after this block are not included.
airdrop_policy: one per unique holder address; exclude the known 0xdead sink; include contract addresses per owner choice
recipient_order: ascending keccak256(abi.encodePacked(public collection seed, address)); lowercase address as deterministic hash-collision tie-break
code_check_note: Code classification was checked at the latest RPC head shortly after the holder snapshot, not at the exact historical block. The owner chose to include contract addresses.
